records.title: PlantCAD2: A DNA foundation model for interpreting genomes across flowering plants.

scope.decision_rationale: This is a primary DNA foundation model for angiosperms. The evidence describes DNA tokenization and masked language modeling, but no natural-language text component.
scope.evidence_snippet: “long-context DNA language model”; “single-nucleotide tokenization”; “masked language modeling objective applied to 8,192 bp input sequences”

architecture.decision_rationale: Primary model paper with broad pretraining on 65 angiosperm genomes and a masked-language-model objective. The evidence supports foundation-model-like pretraining, but it does not explicitly show a genuinely generative architecture.
architecture.evidence_snippet: pre-trained on 65 angiosperm genomes ... masked language modeling objective applied to 8,192 bp input sequences

records.title: OCellus: A Language-Model Framework for Single-Cell, Spatial, and Perturbation Biology with Natural-Language Reasoning

scope.decision_rationale: This is a primary multimodal model paper. The model uses a language-model backbone for biological tasks and explicitly generates natural-language explanations and a natural-language interface.
scope.evidence_snippet: “shared Qwen3.5-9B backbone”; “natural-language explanations”; “Planner–Router–Verifier natural-language interface”; “encodes … spatial coordinates as … sectors of text”

architecture.decision_rationale: The core model is a Qwen3.5-9B language-model backbone adapted with LoRA and used to generate natural-language explanations. The contribution is a biomedical framework built around an existing foundation model.
architecture.evidence_snippet: a single nine-billion-parameter language model (Qwen3.5-9B) ... generates natural-language explanations of its outputs

records.title: GEM-GPT Enables Personalized Cell Type-Resolved Therapeutic Design for Systems Pharmacology.

scope.decision_rationale: The paper is a primary generative biology model for transcriptomics-conditioned molecule design. The evidence supports biological conditioning, but no substantive natural-language/text component in the model itself.
scope.evidence_snippet: “transcriptomics-based molecule generation framework”; “couples a single-cell RNA-sequencing foundation model with a molecular GPT model”

architecture.decision_rationale: This is a transcriptomics-conditioned molecule generation framework using a molecular GPT model plus a scRNA-seq foundation model. The paper presents a primary generative model rather than a wrapper.
architecture.evidence_snippet: a transcriptomics-based molecule generation framework ... couples a single-cell RNA-sequencing foundation model with a molecular GPT model

records.title: Building Knowledge-Enhanced AI Co-Scientists for Biomedical Discovery

scope.decision_rationale: This is a wrapper/system paper that integrates external foundation-model embeddings and external LLMs for downstream spatial and report tasks. The text element is present, but it is used as an attached component rather than a new primary text-bio foundation model.
scope.evidence_snippet: “integrating external knowledge as embeddings extracted from FMs”; “GPT-4o and o1”; “gene information as prompts”; “text embeddings of gene information”

architecture.decision_rationale: spEMO integrates existing foundation models and uses GPT-4o/o1 to generate medical reports. The main contribution is a multimodal application framework, not a new generative model.
architecture.evidence_snippet: spEMO can generate medical reports ... multi-modal agents used in this task are GPT-4o and o1

records.title: scDifformer: diffusion-based post-training for virtual cell modeling across large-scale single-cell data

scope.decision_rationale: This is a primary single-cell foundation model with diffusion post-training. The evidence stays within transcriptomic tokens and cell data, with no natural-language text component.
scope.evidence_snippet: “masked language model pre-training, diffusion-driven post-training”; “large-scale single-cell data”; “34.2 million cells”

architecture.decision_rationale: The model explicitly adds a denoising diffusion module and is pretrained on 34.2 million cells for virtual cell modeling. This is clear generative foundation-model evidence.
architecture.evidence_snippet: augmented with a denoising diffusion module ... pre-training on 36.77 million human single-cell transcriptomes

records.title: Geometric Representations of Knowledge Inside Biological Large Language Models: an Empirical Analysis

scope.decision_rationale: This is an empirical analysis of existing single-cell foundation models, not a new primary model. The representations are transcriptome-based, with no natural-language text component.
scope.evidence_snippet: “We conduct a systematic empirical analysis of four SCFMs”; “trained with the same masked-token recipe on transcriptomes”

architecture.decision_rationale: This is an empirical analysis of existing single-cell foundation models, not a new model contribution. The models discussed are masked-token transcriptome models rather than a new generative architecture.
architecture.evidence_snippet: single-cell foundation models (SCFMs) ... trained with the same masked-token recipe on transcriptomes

records.title: Lineage-Independent Structural Risk Detection in SARS- CoV-2 Spike Protein via Zero-Shot Protein Language Modeling

scope.decision_rationale: This is a zero-shot application of an existing protein language model to structural risk scoring, not a new text-bio model. The evidence is limited to protein sequence modeling and score aggregation.
scope.evidence_snippet: “applies the protein language model ESM-2, without fine-tuning”; “masked-token log-likelihood ratios”

architecture.decision_rationale: The paper applies the existing ESM-2 protein language model zero-shot for structural risk scoring. This is an application wrapper, not a new generative model.
architecture.evidence_snippet: applies the protein language model ESM-2, without fine-tuning on epidemiological outcome labels

scope.decision_rationale: The provided evidence is truncated, but what is shown centers on PubTator-derived gene relations and graph construction rather than a substantive text-bio generative model. No clear natural-language component is evidenced.
scope.evidence_snippet: “relations were obtained from the pre-annotated PubTator3 table”; “treat these regulations as undirected graphs”

architecture.decision_rationale: The selected sections only describe construction of gene regulatory networks from PubTator3 relations. No foundation-model or generative architecture is evidenced.
architecture.evidence_snippet: Gene regulatory relationships were obtained from the pre-annotated PubTator3 table ...

records.title: Miniaturizing and modifying natural proteins with Raygun

scope.decision_rationale: Raygun is a primary generative protein-design method, but the evidence is entirely protein-sequence/PLM based. No natural-language text component or substantive text-bio bridge is described.
scope.evidence_snippet: Protein language models generate informative per-residue representations; Raygun implements this representation within an auto-encoder operating on ESM-2 embeddings

architecture.decision_rationale: The full text describes an auto-encoder with an explicit decoder and generative sampling, trained self-supervised on a large protein corpus. It also reports task-agnostic generation and transfer across protein families.
architecture.evidence_snippet: “support generative sampling” and “a one-step recycling iteration ... improves quality and diversity”

records.title: Unify learns cellular evolution with universal multimodal embeddings

scope.decision_rationale: Unify is a transfer-learning framework for scRNA-seq integration that combines RNA expression with precomputed language-model embeddings. The text side is used as external embeddings, not as a substantive text-bio generative model.
scope.evidence_snippet: combining RNA expression with embeddings from protein language models and general-purpose language models

architecture.decision_rationale: The record describes a transfer-learning framework for universal cell embeddings, not a generative model. It does show broad pretrained language-model embeddings and cross-species transfer.
architecture.evidence_snippet: “learns universal cell embeddings” by combining RNA expression with embeddings from protein language models and general-purpose language models

records.title: scMIR: a vision-language foundation model for single-cell light microscopy image representation

scope.decision_rationale: scMIR is presented as a vision-language foundation model with paired microscopy images and textual captions. The text-guided alignment is central to the model, so this is within scope.
scope.evidence_snippet: trained on paired single-cell images and structured textual captions to enable text-guided visual representation learning

architecture.decision_rationale: scMIR is presented as a pretrained vision-language representation model with reconstruction and alignment modules, but the outputs are task-agnostic embeddings rather than generated outputs. The evidence supports foundation-model-like pretraining and broad applicability.
architecture.evidence_snippet: “pre-trained on 207,957 image-text pairs” and “outputs task-agnostic image embeddings”

records.title: CellDuality: Unlocking Biological Reasoning in LLMs with Self-Supervised RLVR.

scope.decision_rationale: CellDuality is a primary LLM-based biological reasoning method: it defines biological tasks, constructs textual prompts, and trains the model to generate textual responses. The text-biology bridge is explicit and central.
scope.evidence_snippet: All inputs to the LLM are constructed as textual prompts x; The model's output is a textual response y

architecture.decision_rationale: This is a training and reasoning framework around an LLM policy, with teacher-generated CoT data, rather than evidence of a new broadly pretrained foundation model. The model itself is described as generating responses autoregressively.
architecture.evidence_snippet: “the model outputs a textual response y generated autoregressively according to the policy”
